notes: Fandom wiki (skull-and-bones.fandom.com) is inaccessible (403), and Game8 stopped updating after launch ships, so seasonal ships lack a two-source stat database. Cross-checked where possible (Frigate hull: official Y2S2 notes + u4gm; Snow upgrade stats: mp1st + updatecrazy; Padewakang: GameSpot + hard-drive.net). Base armor rating is derived from the equipped armor piece for every ship; no published base values exist, so armor is null throughout. Base turning is likewise unpublished for all ships (Luke's Frigate 'Help me?' showed Turning 25 with a specific loadout, not base). Furniture major/minor split is only known for the Padewakang (1 major + 3 basic); all other ships list totals only. No base hull/brace/speed/furniture/weapon-layout numbers were found anywhere for Battle Junk, Schooner, Sloop of War, or Galleon (perks only, all official); Corvette hull 80,000 is single-source; Frigate base brace/furniture and Junk base speed are single-source. Ship rank system changed in Y2: ships now upgrade to rank 9 (ship upgrade 6/7, ascension, World Tiers, Mastery); large ships listed at base rank 5. Known discrepancies: Sambuk Scorched +50% vs Ablaze (skullandbones.online) vs +30% (pcgamesn, twinfinite) — used 50% with flag; Frigate blueprint cost resolved to 45 Smuggler Marks (free track). Luke's anchors: Frigate 'Help me?' level 7 (hull 167035, armor 2414); Brig 'In Too Deep' is his ram build; owns 25+ ships total.
